correctness.rationale: The 84 perfect matchings, 42 single-edge incidence counts of 28, and all 861 even pair co-occurrences were checked against two structurally independent exact recurrences. The degree-two inclusion–exclusion expansion gives W(S)=4 mod8 for all 2^42 edge subsets, not merely tested signings. A rigorous 27-edge spanning-tree gauge reduces the absolute spectrum to 2^15 representatives, each evaluated by integer Walsh transform and an independent direct sum; nonvanishing, full rank, smallest 4 and largest 84 yield condition number 21. A standalone executable is embedded.

value.rationale: A canonical highly symmetric exceptional cubic graph with even perfect-matching count unexpectedly has no signed cancellation at any of 2^42 frequencies. The modulo-eight conclusion is structurally certified by the parity of all pair incidences, while the full six-level spectrum and sharp l2 condition number are a motivated finite exact benchmark for Fourier deconvolution and signed dimer statistics. No infinite-family significance is asserted.
